scope: Exact joint closed-world snapshots with a two-source INNER JOIN -> WHERE -> GROUP/HAVING and a second shared-source window or set-tree terminal. One snapshot per physical source; never conjoin independently constructed populations.

dialect_policy: All 13 parser dialects must be checked for equivalent canonical shapes; native runtime verification only DuckDB unless separately executed.
supported_types: Signed integer and SQL NULL with exact inclusive bounds; set-tree also requires stable text identity and positional integer tuples.
oracle_policy: Each mandatory case must compare full native physical inputs, complete terminal bags, selected/NOT TRUE identities, canonical typed domains, and requested count/histogram classification. Contradictions require a complete attested physical source assignment.

adapter_policy.native_vendor: conditional; no native engine claim except DuckDB
adapter_policy.sql_tdg: pinned consumer qualification mandatory before Done
